notes: Simpler Settings: your own AI keys and services (OpenRouter, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, Ollama and other APIs) are hidden for now. The built-in free AI covers it, no keys or setup needed
🆓 More free AI with no sign-in, built in like Puter: Llama 3.3 70B, GPT-OSS 120B, Qwen 3.5 397B and Mistral Small 3.2 (OVHcloud) plus LLM7 sit next to Glow Free. No key, no account
Auto-switch: when one free AI is busy or used up, the next one answers the same message right away (OVHcloud, LLM7 and Glow Free, then the AI on this device). A used-up one is skipped for a minute
⬆ The version button now fits every window: on narrower screens it shows just its icon (an update still says Update) instead of pushing the top bar off the screen
GlowRoom shows the version / Update button too, and always loads the newest Glow (it could keep an old copy with the update button hidden in a menu)
↩ Glow reopens where you left off: the app you were in, the chat you had open and the message you hadn't sent yet (turn it off in the Glow apps menu)
⬆ Your version is always shown at the top of every Glow app; when a new version is ready it turns into an orange Update button
Updates install by themselves when Glow opens or when you switch away, never in the middle of a reply; then "Glow updated" shows What's new
